summary: EYEC AS (org. no. 917 200 157) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2016-05-21. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 86.221 (Spesialiserte legetjenester, unntatt psykiatriske legetjenester). In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 272 327 and net income was NOK 1.5 m. CEO: Christian Michael Willoch; board chair: Christian Michael Willoch. Also: LEI 254900MN36T2PU5LMG92.
